rules: Metrics and scores MUST use JetBrains Mono to ensure tabular lining.
Section headers must be uppercase with wide tracking.
DO NOT use generic purple gradients. FORBIDDEN COLOR: #7351B7.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers, dialogs, or dropdowns. Use solid dark colors with 1px borders.
Signal colors (green/yellow/red) should be used purely for metrics (Faithfulness, Precision) and must have high contrast against #0A0A0C.

global.structure: Grid-based. 250px fixed sidebar on left, 1fr main content area on right.
global.spacing: Tight padding (p-4 or p-6) to maximize data density.
global.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px borders (border-white/10) to separate all major panels.

panels.Chat: Two-column bento layout: Left column (60%) for conversational UI. Right column (40%) for retrieved context chunks side-by-side.
panels.Evaluation_Dashboard: Top row: 3 big metric cards (grid-cols-3). Middle row: Line chart spanning full width. Bottom: Data table for per-question analysis.
panels.Documents: Full width dense data table with monospace stats (n_chunks, updated_at).
panels.Sidebar: Dense vertical stack. Must include real-time health stats, radio group for retrieval mode, and slider for top-k.

rules: Use 'Grid Borders' pattern: Items should have right and bottom borders to create a technical table-like feel.
No rounded, soft floating cards. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm max.
Always align numbers and metrics to the right.

citations.style: Inline markers [1], [2]. text-xs font-mono bg-white/10 text-white px-1 rounded-sm cursor-pointer border border-white/20 transition-colors
citations.interaction: Hovering a citation MUST highlight the corresponding context chunk in the right panel.

context_chunks.header: Flex row, source name + score (mono, color-coded)

metric_cards.style: border border-white/10 bg-[#111114] p-6 flex flex-col gap-2
metric_cards.label: text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-500

controls.radios: Square radio buttons or segmented control with sharp edges.

tables.header: border-b border-white/10 text-xs font-mono uppercase text-neutral-500 pb-2

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-20) over the main background to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.badges: Langfuse trace badges should look like terminal tags: border border-blue-500/30 bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 text-xs font-mono px-2 py-0.5.
visual_enhancers.scrollbars: MUST be customized. Width 4px, thumb bg-white/20, track transparent.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on citations and table rows must be snappy (150ms).
motion.transitions: Use transition-colors for hover states. Do NOT use transition-all.
motion.charts: Recharts should have minimal entrance animations, prioritizing immediate data rendering.

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds MUST meet APCA guidelines. Use text-white over dark panels.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden for decorative borders and grid lines.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use Shadcn UI extensively (Tabs, Slider, Radio Group, Table), but override their soft rounded styles with border-radius: 0 or rounded-sm, and replace default grays with the custom dark palette.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: For the Eval Dashboard line chart, use `recharts` with a dark theme configuration (grid lines border-white/10, tooltips dark background with solid borders).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement the Chat panel with a dual-pane view: messages on left, retrieved chunks on right. Connect inline citations to chunks visually.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Sidebar must feel like a lab control panel. Prominent Top-K slider and hybrid/dense/keyword toggle.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT center the layout. Everything must be left-aligned or grid-aligned to maintain the scientific dashboard structure.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid dark backgrounds.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific properties.
NEVER center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (hover state, focus ring).
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case based on role (e.g., data-testid='top-k-slider').
Use sonner for toast notifications. Ensure the toast background is dark and not transparent.
